title: Fix missing default item journal batch in Contoso Inventory setup
summary: Inventory's default item journal batch is now created with its template during Contoso setup, removing the dependency on Manufacturing, Service, or Jobs modules for this creation.
key_points: Create Item Journal Template now also creates Inventory's default item journal batch
Common and Warehouse generation no longer depends on Manufacturing, Service or Jobs to create that batch
Reuses an existing helper and keeps the settings of a batch that already exists
Three regression tests cover batch creation, an existing template without a batch, and keeping customized settings
